set.body:
PRD IO-1, IO-2, IO-2a, P-1. Integration gate for the EyeLink ASC implementation under epic bd-01M039NWZN0BNEDYHVXZFB29CQ.

Acceptance criteria:
- Pure stateful parser and FS2 adapter recover configured samples, pupil, native fixation/saccade/blink evidence, START/END, tracker metadata, and experiment messages with source locations.
- Parsing is bounded-memory and invariant to arbitrary byte and line chunking.
- Left/right/binocular identity, GAZE/HREF/RAW, pupil representation, missingness, optional fields, block-specific configuration, message offsets, and unknown records follow the published support contract.
- Stimulus messages land in ObservedTimeline on their source clock; planned timestamps are never promoted to observed.
- Native EyeLink events remain vendor evidence and are not represented as eyes4s DetectionResult.
- Every unsupported layout or missing requirement fails explicitly; no line, eye, time, unit, or provenance is silently discarded.
- Component children and integration tests are green on JVM and Scala.js before this bead closes.
